Meet up with us there.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|}} The '''Jedi monument''' was an old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temple on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] and the burial site of [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. ==History== {{Quote|Master, I'm sensing something strange.''"
"''Me too. Be careful Anakin, there are powerful forces guarding Ulic's tomb. They will not let you enter without a fight.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|}} [[File:Ulics_Tomb.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the tomb of [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], inside the Jedi monument]] During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces [[Evacuation of Rhen Var|attacked]] and eliminated a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Bravo Base|outpost]] situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] to allow access to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] monument in search for information pertaining to the [[Dark Reaper]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] creation. During a [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|later engagement]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] led the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] to recapture the monument. Anakin penetrated the temple after the outer defenses were destroyed, and had to prove himself by defeating a trio of [[spectral guardian]]s. After the ordeal, Skywalker communicated with [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] and learned how to survive the effects of the Reaper. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{FactFile|107|SUR 3-6|The Survival of Boba Fett}} *''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' *{{CSWECite|III||spectral guardian}} *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Jedi temples]] [[Category:Rhen Var locations]]
